title: GCS-03: Spurious Link Quality with GNSS Error

fields.subject: GCS-03: 100% 915 MHz link quality but GNSS error and no RTK fix
fields.description: Field: GCS-03 showing 100% link quality on 915 MHz, but HMI shows 'No RTK fix' and 'GNSS error'. Payload Operator says the calibration tarps were not on the ground at 09:10. Is the GCS-03 baseline corrupted? Request: verify baseline on HUOG-NAS01\it\baselines\ and check for unauthorized config changes.

activity.author: Field Crew (Trainee)
activity.text: Ticket raised via internal portal. GCS-03 is active in the hangar. Link quality is 100% but telemetry shows no RTK fix and GNSS error. Payload Operator confirmed tarps not on ground at 09:10. Baseline verification required.

activity.author: System
activity.text: Ticket created and routed to assignment group 'Systems & Cybersecurity'.

instructorNote: This is a red herring. The baseline on GCS-03 is intact; the issue is a spoofed telemetry feed. The TL must verify the baseline hash before acting.
